text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali on Friday chaired a cabinet meeting on health sector.
- President Ben Ali stressed the necessity for Tunisians to consume local-made products.
- Tunisia on Saturday celebrates the consumer's world day.
- Great opportunities offered to Saudi Arabian and Tunisian businessmen to boost investment in the two countries.
- Gafsa airport in southern Tunisia scheduled to be operational in July 1998.
- Tunisia and Greece aim to reinforce cooperation on tourism sector.
